findings.title: 部分close后缺少阻止新admission的reconciliation状态
findings.trigger: 已确认旧Job清理后close事务第一个checkpoint写成功，第二个ownership写失败
findings.observed: checkpoint active UUID已清空，ownership仍保留ACTIVE_ISOLATED_PHASE；failed.partial.json有原文但activate未消费此阻断事实，用当前两文件pins可接纳新UUID
findings.impact: 未完成的canonical二文件变更可被下一次admission覆盖，绕过原文要求的Root reconciliation
findings.requested: 持久记录并在每次update_pair/activate进入前检查未完成事务，或让activate验证checkpoint与ownership的成对lease状态并拒绝不一致；失败close不可留下可直接新admit的空active状态
findings.evidence_limit: pure Python in-memory filesystem and WinAPI substitutes; second invocation explicit, not proof of automatic retry or actual Windows failure

findings.title: watchdog线程启动失败使duplicate句柄清理和原始receipt路径中断
findings.trigger: DuplicateHandle已成功，Thread对象已赋值，但Thread.start()抛出异常
findings.observed: stop_and_close无条件join未启动线程又抛RuntimeError，未调用close(self.handle)；controller finally在此处退出，后续phase-launch.invocation.json写入被跳过
findings.impact: 重复Job句柄泄漏，原始native结果/第一失败可能没有封存；不符合清理边界
findings.requested: 显式跟踪thread是否成功启动；无论start/join错误都在finally关闭能安全关闭的duplicate，保留错误原文并返回清理状态；controller finally应隔离watchdog cleanup异常以继续封存original result/receipt且保持未确认lease
findings.evidence_limit: pure selected start/stop AST with synthetic Thread/Event/handles; no real thread or WinAPI invoked

findings.title: observer已验证worker字节与Resume后的实际文件加载之间仍可漂移
findings.trigger: observer最后一次pin/compile检查后，Root写grant/input并Resume之前或Python打开worker路径之前，worker文件改变
findings.observed: observer编译结果被丢弃，返回launch argv/pins；实际CreateProcess参数仍以worker文件路径启动，controller未对该文件保持deny-write/delete所有权，也未让Python消费那个已验证buffer
findings.impact: 同PID、正确Job、正确argv/cwd并不能证明最终加载的是被审查worker代码
findings.requested: 在检查到整个加载/执行边界保持实际文件不可变所有权并覆盖相关入口源码，或使用受审查的稳定执行buffer方案；将该机制纳入Source和真正OS probe，不能只补一次hash读取或自报intent
findings.evidence_limit: static path-consumption analysis and memory timeline only; no real worker mutation, CreateProcess or execution
